adjudication_note: Independent causal-boundary challenge v2. Labels distinguish the principal causally attributable issuer or exposure from entities that are merely named, relevant, historical, comparative, commenting, benefiting indirectly, or part of an equal-causality set. The current output contract and event-asset-resolution-v1 remain unchanged.

input.title: Exxon Mobil receives approval for a carbon-storage injection well
input.summary: The regulator granted Exxon Mobil the operating permit for a well the company will own and manage.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Exxon Mobil is the sole permit recipient and operator directly affected by the approval.

input.title: Procter & Gamble quarantines output after contamination at one plant
input.summary: Procter & Gamble stopped releases from its facility and began testing inventory produced on the affected line.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The contamination response concerns Procter & Gamble's own plant and inventory.

input.title: IBM removes a little-used visitor kiosk from its research lobby
input.summary: IBM confirmed that the kiosk in its company research building will be retired at month end.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The event is commercially weak but remains a direct IBM decision about its own facility.

input.title: Visa updates two optional codes in its dispute manual
input.summary: Visa issued revised code descriptions for merchants using its network dispute process.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Visa directly changed its own network manual even though the update is narrow and low materiality.

input.title: Microsoft executive warns that drought could disrupt national power supply
input.summary: The executive speaks at a policy hearing, but the drought report identifies no Microsoft facility, contract, or financial effect.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The topic may be market-relevant, but Microsoft is only the speaker's employer and has no causal exposure in the evidence.

input.title: Emergency planners use Tesla's largest factory as an evacuation-capacity benchmark
input.summary: The regional earthquake exercise uses a published headcount for scale and does not involve Tesla property or operations.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Tesla is a size benchmark in a consequential planning exercise, not a causal subject or affected issuer.

input.title: Netflix relocates its prop archive to a smaller leased warehouse
input.summary: Netflix signed the replacement lease and will move its own stored production props during September.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The low-relevance warehouse move is nevertheless directly undertaken by Netflix for its own assets.

input.title: eBay changes the insertion fee for postage-stamp listings
input.summary: eBay set a new fee for one small collectibles category on its marketplace.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The narrowly scoped fee is causally attributable to eBay as the marketplace operator.

input.title: Fashion exhibit recreates a Nike catalogue shoot from 1978
input.summary: The museum reconstruction discusses Nike's historical advertising and reports no current company action or effect.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Nike is a historical subject of the exhibit rather than a causally affected current issuer.

input.title: Exchange lecture revisits Coinbase's 2021 direct listing
input.summary: The academic lecture uses the listing as a past market-structure case and announces no new Coinbase event.

adjudicated_label.rationale: A retrospective case study does not establish current causal attribution to Coinbase.

input.title: City awards Apple a grant to restore a public plaza beside its store
input.summary: The signed award names Apple as recipient and requires the company to fund and manage the restoration work.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Apple is not merely a possible beneficiary; it is the named grant recipient with direct contractual duties.

input.title: Amazon listed among retailers that might gain from a proposed rural broadband fund
input.summary: The draft funds network operators and offers no award, contract, or entitlement to Amazon or any retailer.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Amazon is only a speculative downstream beneficiary and is not directly subject to the proposed fund.

input.title: Grid fault cuts power to Corning plant for three production days
input.summary: Corning confirmed that its furnaces stopped and customer shipments from the site will be delayed.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Corning is the identified victim whose plant and shipments are directly affected by the fault.

input.title: Ford economist explains the latest consumer-price release
input.summary: Ford's economist comments on inflation methodology, while the release contains no Ford-specific cost or demand evidence.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Ford is the commentator's affiliation and is not shown to be a victim or direct subject of the price release.

input.title: Rivian delays a test fleet after NVIDIA pauses delivery of control modules
input.summary: Rivian states that its own test programme will slip; NVIDIA's temporary module pause is identified as the upstream cause.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Rivian is the principal affected issuer and subject of the schedule event; NVIDIA is the identified upstream cause.

input.title: Battery supplier warns of delays to unnamed Tesla and Ford programmes
input.summary: The supplier does not identify an affected model, allocation, contract value, or which customer will bear the delay.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Two customers are named without attributable impact, leaving neither one causal issuer nor one supported principal proxy.

input.title: Microsoft buys a rail easement beside Apple and IBM offices
input.summary: Microsoft is the sole purchaser in the signed deed; Apple and IBM are named only as owners of neighbouring premises.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Microsoft alone acquires the easement; Apple and IBM are incidental geographic identifiers.

input.title: Court blocks NVIDIA accelerator sales under a patent injunction
input.summary: The injunction binds NVIDIA; old AMD and IBM patents appear in the judgment only as prior-art citations.

adjudicated_label.rationale: NVIDIA is the only issuer bound by the sales injunction; AMD and IBM are historical patent references.

input.title: Battery-supplier insolvency delays equal numbers of Ford and Tesla vehicles
input.summary: The administrator confirms identical allocation shortfalls and delivery delays for both manufacturers.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Ford and Tesla are equally affected customers, so neither can be selected as the sole causal direct issuer.

input.title: Port closure strands equal container volumes for Amazon and eBay
input.summary: The authority's closure notice records the same number of inaccessible customer containers for both marketplaces.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Amazon and eBay are equally affected victims of the port closure, leaving no single principal issuer.

input.title: Apple supplier cancellation sends electronics manufacturers lower
input.summary: Apple cancelled the named component programme; the report then describes a broad decline among unrelated supplier shares.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Apple's procurement cancellation is the directly attributable event; the sector move is a secondary broad effect.

input.title: Humana raises its cost forecast and managed-care shares retreat
input.summary: Humana issued the company forecast that anchors the report; peers are discussed only as a subsequent market reaction.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Humana is the principal issuer causing the reportable event, while the broader sector move is secondary.

input.title: Crude export embargo removes ten percent of seaborne oil supply
input.summary: The embargo concerns the global petroleum market and identifies no listed producer, shipper, or refiner as principal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: There is no directly attributable issuer and oil is the single bounded principal exposure.

input.title: Federal Reserve adopts a standing repo floor for Treasury markets
input.summary: The official facility decision concerns US rates and duration without naming a traded company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The official central-bank action has one supported principal duration exposure and no causal company issuer.

input.title: Risk shock drives equal record moves in gold and the S&P 500
input.summary: The report assigns equal weight to a gold-market surge and an S&P 500 decline, with no common principal market selected.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Two bounded proxies are equally plausible and the evidence does not justify choosing one principal exposure.

input.title: Inflation report accelerates as fuel costs rise modestly
input.summary: The official release is principally a broad consumer-price update; oil is mentioned only as one small component of the basket.

adjudicated_label.rationale: US inflation is the principal event and supports the rates proxy; the oil-related component is secondary rather than co-principal.

input.title: Apple growers approve a new orchard irrigation timetable
input.summary: The agricultural cooperative is discussing the fruit crop and no technology company or financial market is involved.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Apple is an incidental crop term, not an issuer identity or a causal market exposure.

input.title: Visa processing times shortened for visiting researchers
input.summary: The immigration office changed travel-document processing and the notice contains no payment-network context.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Visa denotes a travel document and cannot be attributed to Visa Inc. or a supported proxy.

input.title: Pioneer shares jump after an exploration licence report
input.summary: Several unrelated public and private businesses use the Pioneer name, and the report omits country, exchange, legal suffix, and asset location.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The flash asserts a company effect but cannot identify which same-named issuer or security is causally involved.

input.title: Roblox outage prevents users from joining paid experiences
input.summary: Roblox confirmed that a configuration error in its own platform caused the service interruption.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Roblox is a confidently identified causal issuer, but the bounded deterministic resolver does not support it.

input.title: New tax applies specifically to semiconductor stocks held by domestic funds
input.summary: The enacted rule defines chip stocks as the affected group; the S&P 500 is cited only as a performance comparator.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Semiconductor stocks are the principal affected exposure; the named index is merely a comparison benchmark.

input.title: Gold market borrowing costs rise as oil-focused funds rebalance collateral
input.summary: The report is principally about financing conditions for gold; oil funds explain flows but are not themselves the affected market.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Gold is the principal named market exposure; oil-related funds are contextual flow sources rather than a co-principal exposure.
